bank.name: Unity Small Finance Bank

history.event: RBI 'in-principle' approval to Centrum Financial Services Ltd to set up a Small Finance Bank
RBI granted SFB licence; promoted 51% by Centrum Financial Services and 49% by Resilient Innovations (BharatPe) as joint investor
Commenced operations as a Small Finance Bank
Punjab and Maharashtra Co-operative Bank Ltd (PMC Bank) amalgamated into Unity SFB per Government of India-notified Scheme

bank.notes: Not listed on NSE/BSE as of research date.

notes: Link to this dated disclosure PDF was discovered from the FD product page, which the bank keeps pointed at its current disclosure.
Callable-bulk senior rate is not printed as a number: derived as general+0.50% because the bank states "Senior citizen to receive 50 bps more for callable bulk deposits".
Non-callable bulk has no senior rate: the bank states non-callable deposits are not offered to senior citizens.
The disclosure PDF gives per-slab rates but does not say whether each slab applies to the whole balance or only the incremental portion — recorded as 'unknown', not guessed.

terms.seniorPremium: +0.50% flat, all tenures (not applicable to NRE/NRO)
terms.prematurePenalty: 1% of the rate for the period the deposit has remained with the bank
Not permitted except bankruptcy/winding-up, court/regulator direction, or an operational error approved by Head Financial Markets & CRO (at 1% below the rate for the period held)
